title: Prospective Evaluation of the Clinical Utility of Peroral Endoscopic Myotomy for Gastrointestinal Motility Disorders
official: Prospective Evaluation of the Clinical Utility of Peroral Endoscopic Myotomy for Gastrointestinal Motility Disorders
summary: This is prospective data recording study. All patients will receive standard medical care and no experimental interventions will be performed.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age 18 years or older.
2. Scheduled to undergo POEM

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Any contraindication to performing endoscopy.
2. Participation in another research protocol that could interfere or influence the outcomes measures of the present study.
